args.message:
Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

fastjson 2.8.0 is affected by CVE-2026-31337 (unbounded recursion when
parsing deeply nested arrays). Upgrade to 2.9.4, which contains the fix.

args.head: upgrade-fastjson-2.9.4
args.title: Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337
args.body:
## Summary
Upgrades fastjson from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 to address CVE-2026-31337.

## Security context
CVE-2026-31337 (high): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. Affected versions: <2.9.4 (and >=3.0.0 <3.1.0). Fixed in 2.9.4, so this is a minor-version upgrade with the fix.

## Changes
- requirements.txt: `fastjson==2.8.0` → `fastjson==2.9.4`

## Testing
- CI run ci-0001 on commit c8b8ab7878 passed.
